title: "Messaging and stream processing"
---

*Sample chapter for the proposed course plan.*

## Learning outcome

Explain why a message consumer may see the same event twice.

**Prerequisites:** Lectures 03, 05, and 08.

## Core idea

A message broker decouples the time at which a producer sends work from the time at which a consumer processes it. Under at-least-once delivery, a consumer must be prepared to receive a message more than once.

## Worked scenario

A notification consumer sends an email but loses its acknowledgement. The broker redelivers the confirmation event.

## Discussion

Where could duplicate detection live, and what would it need to remember?

## Recap

A delivery guarantee must be connected to the effects performed by the consumer.
